snapshot.description: Top-level AOI thematic analysis surface for one selected source thinker. Organizes source documents, theme-led findings, sin-type groupings, and the structured report under one parent container.
Inventory of the selected source thinker's documents used to ground the AOI thematic analysis.
Theme-first AOI surface. Each theme becomes one accordion section exposing the source-theme overview, Benanav's engagement, and the flat findings tied to that theme.
AOI findings regrouped by the first-class sin taxonomy so the same bounded finding set can be inspected by misuse pattern rather than by source theme.
Structured AOI closeout over the selected thinker: summary, engagement pattern, key divergences, sin distribution, and reading implications.
